reading: Germany has blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.
Russia says it did not carry out the attack.
A robot made an explosive drone safe.
The airport is used by Ukrainian transport planes.
The EU and Nato say they will put more pressure on Russia.
Russia is accused of acting more recklessly.

vocabulary.definition: said to have done something wrong
an aircraft that flies without a pilot inside
without enough care for safety or danger
strong efforts to make someone change what they do

entries.ja: 誰かに責任があると言った。
